selection.assessment: The media plan responds to Utrecht’s interdisciplinary structure and current media direction through media history, representation, documentary, audiences, research and social science. The sustainability plan combines environmental systems with policy and justice. The digital society plan combines AI methods with media and social inquiry. A fourth culture and global society direction has supporting courses in culture, politics, inequality and identity, and shares much of the broad media option’s focus. The comparison already presents three distinct options.

routeSelection.basis: Utrecht’s current package guidance identifies Media Industries, Identities and Heritage as the successor to the first-listed Film and Television Studies direction. The example follows that successor and illustrates Doing Media Heritage, with the remaining main-direction choice subject to approval.

comparator.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 example combines 60 EC of General Education, a 67.5 EC media main direction and 52.5 EC of profiling space. The media direction includes the Doing Media Heritage package, preparation, a research seminar, an approved direction elective and a final paper. General Education includes a separate interdisciplinary paper. Students also maintain a portfolio.

alternatives.label: Media, Culture and Society
alternatives.labelReason: Study how media shapes culture and public life. Explore film, documentary, media history and representation alongside sociology, politics, audience research and data analysis.
alternatives.concept: Study how media shapes culture and public life. Explore film, documentary, media history and representation alongside sociology, politics, audience research and data analysis.
progression: Introductory media, rhetoric and sociology precede advanced media analysis, production and social theory. Research methods precedes consumer engagement and organisational psychology. Entrepreneurship precedes Market Research.

alternatives.label: Sustainability, Environment and Public Policy
alternatives.labelReason: Study climate, water, energy and environmental change. Combine environmental science and data with economics, law, governance and public communication to explore responses to sustainability problems.
alternatives.concept: Study climate, water, energy and environmental change. Combine environmental science and data with economics, law, governance and public communication to explore responses to sustainability problems.
alternatives.distinctness: The environmental plan develops environmental processes, spatial analysis, energy and delta adaptation, alongside environmental governance and justice.
progression: Sustainability and economics foundations come before applied public economics, energy analysis and governance. Introduction to Environmental Science precedes environmental mapping and advanced environmental analysis. International relations precedes peace and conflict.

alternatives.label: Digital Society, AI and Media
alternatives.labelReason: Study how digital systems shape communication and society. Combine programming, machine learning and AI ethics with media history, representation and the study of digital publics.
alternatives.concept: Study how digital systems shape communication and society. Combine programming, machine learning and AI ethics with media history, representation and the study of digital publics.
alternatives.distinctness: The digital society plan gives sustained attention to software, data, AI methods and the ethics and public effects of digital systems.
progression: Programming and logic precede algorithms and advanced AI. Introductory data science precedes machine learning and neural networks. Mathematical methods precedes computer vision, and introductory media precedes documentary and advanced media analysis.

notes.text: Utrecht combines a required interdisciplinary core with an approved main direction and open profiling space. This example includes two final papers, one in interdisciplinary research and one in media. The UCR options develop related skills across their courses and offer optional independent research.

audience.programmeDescription: Utrecht Liberal Arts and Sciences combines interdisciplinary study with a main direction. This example follows Media Industries, Identities and Heritage.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The 2026–2027 example uses the Doing Media Heritage package. The UCR options illustrate three ways to combine humanities, sciences and social sciences around a subject.
